algorithm: closed-loop Transformer policy (BC, Gaussian NLL loss) over a morphology-agnostic 3D-point state-action space (triangulated object keypoints + thumb/index 3D coordinates + a thresholded grasp scalar)
hand: Franka Panda parallel-jaw gripper (not a dexterous hand; see note scope flag)
headline_metric: zero-shot real-robot task success rate (15 trials/task, no in-domain robot data)
headline_value: EgoZero: Open oven 13/15, Pick bread 11/15, Sweep broom 9/15, Erase board 11/15, Sort fruit 11/15, Fold towel 10/15, Insert book 9/15; From-vision baseline 0/15 on all tasks; From-affordances baseline ranges 0/15-12/15 (Table 1)
human_data: own Project Aria smart-glasses egocentric video (self-collected, not a public dataset); 100 demonstrations per task x 7 tasks = 700 total, collected across 2-3 environments with multiple demonstrators
operator_interface: Project Aria smart glasses (egocentric fisheye RGB + SLAM cameras + onboard hand/camera pose tracking), no glove, no live teleoperation of a robot during data collection; at inference an iPhone provides the egocentric view instead of Aria
retargeting_objective: no kinematic hand-to-robot retargeting; both human and robot are represented in a shared morphology-agnostic 3D-point space so the policy transfers zero-shot without any cross-embodiment pose-mapping step
